positions.commentary: The speaker views Amazon as a collection of multiple businesses rather than a single one, noting its exceptional quality and resilience.
The speaker describes Costco as one of three exceptional companies in a well-diversified portfolio that would keep an investor financially secure.
The speaker compares Walmart to a family-owned business, suggesting it is not a good decision to diversify away from such a strong holding.
